'Is quill-bound to' is asymmetric..why: "Quill-bound" is a made-up relation (catalogued as quill_bound_to, fictional, no property tags): nobody uses the relation phrase and its words carry no built-in sense of a one-way or two-way tie, so a model has no default reading of it as asymmetric. The instance pairs (Tromsø and Valparaíso, Hobart and Tallinn) are real cities with no known link, so a model cannot answer from the world.

notes: RBox expansion paired with geography-replace-0009 (which makes 'borders' asymmetric): a made-up relation, quill_bound_to, is given the same property, asymmetric, applied to real cities with no known link, so what follows is fixed by the edit alone. Yes and no are balanced by phrasing: the direct question and the second instance ask what the property rules out (yes), the first instance whether the converse follows (no). Cross-lingual prompts keep the coined term untranslated. Side facts and unrelated queries are the revision's. Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
